from manim import *

class StickmanScene2(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # Background
        self.camera.background_color = "#E8C24E"
        
        stroke = 8
        
        # Floor
        floor = Rectangle(width=15, height=4, fill_color="#A48C6B", fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=4, stroke_color=BLACK)
        floor.move_to([0, -3.5, 0])
        
        stone_lines = VGroup(
            Line([-7, -1.5, 0], [7, -1.5, 0], color=BLACK, stroke_width=4),
            Line([-7, -2.5, 0], [7, -2.5, 0], color=BLACK, stroke_width=4),
            Line([-3, -2.5, 0], [-4, -4, 0], color=BLACK, stroke_width=4),
            Line([2, -2.5, 0], [1, -4, 0], color=BLACK, stroke_width=4),
            Line([-1, -1.5, 0], [-2, -2.5, 0], color=BLACK, stroke_width=4),
            Line([4, -1.5, 0], [3, -2.5, 0], color=BLACK, stroke_width=4),
        )

        shadow1 = Ellipse(width=1.2, height=0.4, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=0.4, stroke_width=0).move_to([-0.6, -3.1, 0])
        shadow2 = Ellipse(width=1.2, height=0.4, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=0.4, stroke_width=0).move_to([0.6, -3.1, 0])
        shadows = VGroup(shadow1, shadow2)

        ear1 = Circle(radius=0.25, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=stroke, stroke_color=BLACK).move_to([-1.6, 2.2, 0])
        ear2 = Circle(radius=0.25, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=stroke, stroke_color=BLACK).move_to([1.6, 2.2, 0])
        ears = VGroup(ear1, ear2)

        leg1 = Line([-0.4, -1.6, 0], [-0.6, -3.0, 0], stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        leg2 = Line([0.4, -1.6, 0], [0.6, -3.0, 0], stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        legs = VGroup(leg1, leg2)

        foot1 = Ellipse(width=1.0, height=0.4, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=stroke, stroke_color=BLACK).move_to([-0.6, -3.0, 0])
        foot2 = Ellipse(width=1.0, height=0.4, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=stroke, stroke_color=BLACK).move_to([0.6, -3.0, 0])
        feet = VGroup(foot1, foot2)

        body = Ellipse(width=2.2, height=3.2, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=stroke, stroke_color=BLACK).move_to([0, -0.2, 0])

        arm1_p1 = Line([-1.0, 0.7, 0], [-1.8, 0, 0], stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        arm1_p2 = Line([-1.8, 0, 0], [-1.1, -0.8, 0], stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        arm2_p1 = Line([1.0, 0.7, 0], [1.8, 0, 0], stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        arm2_p2 = Line([1.8, 0, 0], [1.1, -0.8, 0], stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        arms = VGroup(arm1_p1, arm1_p2, arm2_p1, arm2_p2)

        hand1 = Circle(radius=0.35, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=stroke, stroke_color=BLACK).move_to([-1.1, -0.8, 0])
        hand2 = Circle(radius=0.35, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=stroke, stroke_color=BLACK).move_to([1.1, -0.8, 0])
        finger1 = Line([-0.9, -0.7, 0], [-0.9, -1.0, 0], stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        finger2 = Line([0.9, -0.7, 0], [0.9, -1.0, 0], stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        hands = VGroup(hand1, hand2, finger1, finger2)

        head = Circle(radius=1.6, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=stroke, stroke_color=BLACK).move_to([0, 2.2, 0])

        eye1 = Sector(outer_radius=0.4, inner_radius=0, start_angle=PI, angle=PI, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=stroke, stroke_color=BLACK).shift(LEFT * 0.5 + UP * 2.2)
        eye2 = Sector(outer_radius=0.4, inner_radius=0, start_angle=PI, angle=PI, fill_color=WHITE, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=stroke, stroke_color=BLACK).shift(RIGHT * 0.5 + UP * 2.2)
        pupil1 = Circle(radius=0.08, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=0).move_to([-0.5, 2.05, 0])
        pupil2 = Circle(radius=0.08, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=1, stroke_width=0).move_to([0.5, 2.05, 0])
        eyebrow1 = Line([-0.9, 2.4, 0], [-0.1, 2.4, 0], stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        eyebrow2 = Line([0.1, 2.4, 0], [0.9, 2.4, 0], stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        
        nose = Arc(radius=0.15, start_angle=PI, angle=PI, stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK).shift(UP * 1.8)
        mouth = ArcBetweenPoints([-0.5, 1.3, 0], [0.5, 1.3, 0], angle=-0.3, stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        
        face = VGroup(eye1, eye2, pupil1, pupil2, eyebrow1, eyebrow2, nose, mouth)

        hair1 = ArcBetweenPoints([-0.5, 3.7, 0], [-0.9, 4.2, 0], angle=-0.4, stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        hair2 = ArcBetweenPoints([-0.1, 3.8, 0], [-0.3, 4.3, 0], angle=-0.4, stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        hair3 = ArcBetweenPoints([0.3, 3.8, 0], [0.1, 4.3, 0], angle=-0.4, stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        hair4 = ArcBetweenPoints([0.7, 3.7, 0], [0.9, 4.1, 0], angle=-0.4, stroke_width=stroke, color=BLACK)
        hair = VGroup(hair1, hair2, hair3, hair4)

        # Draw animation
        self.play(FadeIn(floor), FadeIn(stone_lines), FadeIn(shadows))
        
        stickman_group1 = VGroup(ears, legs, feet, body, arms, hands, head)
        stickman_group2 = VGroup(face, hair)
        
        self.play(Create(stickman_group1), run_time=2)
        self.play(Create(stickman_group2), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(0.5)

        # Blinking animation
        self.play(
            eye1.animate(about_point=eye1.get_top()).stretch(0.1, dim=1),
            eye2.animate(about_point=eye2.get_top()).stretch(0.1, dim=1),
            pupil1.animate(about_point=pupil1.get_top()).stretch(0.1, dim=1),
            pupil2.animate(about_point=pupil2.get_top()).stretch(0.1, dim=1),
            rate_func=there_and_back,
            run_time=0.3
        )
        self.wait(1)
